steps.title: Ring around the boss
steps.rule: Spread in a ring 4m around Lindwurm: main tank north, then clockwise off tank, regen healer, shield healer, M1, M2, physical ranged, caster.

steps.title: Wait in your number's quadrant
steps.rule: The clone that tethered you sets your job and number. N, NE, E and SE clones take a stack tether, S, SW, W and NW clones a defamation; N/S clones are 1, NE/SW 2, E/W 3, SE/NW 4. Wait about 6m out in your number's quadrant: 1 between N and NE, 2 between E and SE, 3 between S and SW, 4 between W and NW.

steps.title: Grab your boss clone's tether
steps.rule: Your quadrant holds one defamation clone and one stack clone: take the tether of your kind by standing next to that lindschrat.

steps.title: Dodge the remembered cleaves
steps.cue: Twisted Vision resolves and the tethers lock
steps.rule: Go about 12m out on your light party's side (MT, regen, M1, physical ranged west; OT, shield, M2, caster east), on the north or south half away from the clone that showed east-west cones. Tanks and melee stand a step inside the healers and ranged.

steps.title: Take your tower spot
steps.rule: On your light party's platform, tanks and melee take the inner pair of towers, healers and ranged the outer pair. Supports take the north tower on the west platform and the south tower on the east one; DPS the other.

steps.title: Swap towers by the light
steps.rule: If the light hit you (Light Resistance Down II), you must hold an earth or fire tower; if not, a wind or doom tower. If your tower is the wrong kind, swap with the other player in your column.

steps.title: First tethers resolve
steps.cue: Twisted Vision resolves and the floor comes back
steps.rule: The tethers go off in pairs by their clone: N/S, then NE/SW, E/W, SE/NW. Numbers 1 and 2 play north, 3 and 4 south. On a stack pair, the north group stacks on waymark 1 and the south group on waymark 3. On a defamation pair, the north group's holder runs to the east wall and the south group's to the west wall, while everyone else goes far north or far south with their group.

steps.title: Next three tethers
steps.rule: Same for each remaining pair: on a stack, your group stacks on waymark 1 (north) or 3 (south); on a defamation, the holder runs to their wall (north group east, south group west) and the rest go to their group's far edge.

steps.title: Soak your tower
steps.rule: Go back to your final tower before the floor splits again. Earth and fire: stand in the middle. Doom: stand on its north or south edge, away from the party, so the dark line points out. Wind: stand on the edge facing the arena's middle so the blast throws you onto the other platform.

steps.title: Earth soaker out
steps.rule: The earth tower soaker steps out to the platform's centre (B or D) before Lindwurm's Stone III. Everyone else holds still; the fire soaker is Hot-blooded and must not move.

steps.title: Wind soaker lands
steps.rule: The wind soaker lands on the other platform and holds its inner edge, just north of the middle, to aim Faraway Portent.

steps.title: Portent spots
steps.rule: Doom soaker (Nearby Portent, Esuna'd by a healer): inner north corner of your platform. Inner earth or fire soaker: just outside them, to take their line. Outer earth or fire soaker: the outer south part of your platform, to take the line of the wind soaker who left it. The wind soaker stays where it landed.

steps.title: Stack on the first replays
steps.cue: The floor comes back after Snaking Kick
steps.rule: The first clones to appear replay first. Of their two stack clones, the party stacks on the northern one (N or NE) and the tanks on the eastern one (E or SE); stand just beside it, away from the nearest defamation clone.

MainTank.rule: Stack with the off tank on the eastern stack clone (E or SE), just beside it away from the nearest defamation clone.

OffTank.rule: Stack with the main tank on the eastern stack clone (E or SE), just beside it away from the nearest defamation clone.

steps.title: To the cone clone's platform
steps.cue: The first reenacted Heavy Slams resolve
steps.rule: Go to the platform the Snaking Kick clone did not jump to. If its clone fires east-west cones, stand on the north end of the platform; if north-south cones, on its inner edge.

MainTank.rule: Go to the platform the Snaking Kick clone did not jump to. If its clone fires east-west cones, stand on the south end of the platform; if north-south cones, on its inner edge.

OffTank.rule: Go to the platform the Snaking Kick clone did not jump to. If its clone fires east-west cones, stand on the south end of the platform; if north-south cones, on its inner edge.

steps.title: Stack on the second replays
steps.cue: Twisted Vision resolves and the floor comes back
steps.rule: Now the other clones replay. Again the party stacks beside the northern stack clone (N or NE), away from the nearest defamation clone.

MainTank.rule: Stack with the off tank beside the eastern stack clone (E or SE), away from the nearest defamation clone.

OffTank.rule: Stack with the main tank beside the eastern stack clone (E or SE), away from the nearest defamation clone.

steps.title: Dodge the tear clone
steps.cue: The second reenacted Heavy Slams resolve
steps.rule: The clone that went into the tear comes back north of the middle with its cones. If they fire east-west, stand in the middle, just south of it; if north-south, stand level with it on your light party's side (west or east).
